stories.headline: Russia fires 400+ drones and 110 missiles at Ukraine; missiles land in Poland
stories.summary: Russia's biggest barrage of the year killed at least eight people in Kyiv and damaged bridges and railway stations; two missiles and a suspected drone came down in Poland, which PM Tusk called a deliberate provocation as NATO scrambled jets.

stories.headline: Trump defends ties to Putin and Xi after first trilateral summit
stories.summary: After the first three-way meeting of US, Chinese and Russian leaders in Shenzhen, President Trump called Putin a friend in a 90-minute press conference; Ukraine's President Zelensky answered, "He's a killer."

stories.headline: AI sell-off deepens: S&P 500 and Dow in correction, Nasdaq erases 2026 gains
stories.summary: The AI and chip sell-off pushed both the S&P 500 and the Dow into correction; the Nasdaq wiped out all of its 2026 gains and Anthropic shares fell about 11% a day after its record-setting debut.

stories.headline: COP31 climate talks run past deadline, deadlocked over fossil fuels

sources.name: UN News — COP31: fossil fuel language drops from draft deal

stories.summary: The UN climate summit in Antalya ran into overtime as nearly 200 nations failed to agree; the draft deal drops all mention of fossil fuels, and the EU warned the summit risked becoming a "fossil summit".

stories.headline: Man convicted of starting the deadly Palisades fire
stories.summary: A jury found Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty of arson for starting the January 2025 Palisades fire, which killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings; the verdict came at a retrial.

stories.headline: Pancreatic cancer pill shows major progress in trial
stories.summary: In a trial of the pill daraxonrasib, taken alongside chemotherapy, cancer became undetectable on scans in one in 12 patients and nearly all participants saw their tumours stop growing — called the biggest breakthrough in decades.
